segments.mnd13:3.2: Ye kecīti sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ asesaṃ nissesaṃ pariyādiyanavacanametaṃ –
segments.mnd13:3.6: te dvāsaṭṭhiyā diṭṭhigatānaṃ aññataraññataraṃ diṭṭhigataṃ gahetvā uggahetvā gaṇhitvā parāmasitvā abhinivisitvā sakāya sakāya diṭṭhiyā vasanti saṃvasanti āvasanti parivasanti.
segments.mnd13:3.7: Yathā agārikā vā gharesu vasanti, sāpattikā vā āpattīsu vasanti, sakilesā vā kilesesu vasanti;
segments.mnd13:4.2: “Sassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan”ti vadanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharanti.
segments.mnd13:4.4: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan”ti vadanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharantīti –
segments.mnd13:5.2: Sabbeva te samaṇabrāhmaṇā nindameva anventi, garahameva anventi, akittimeva anventi;
segments.mnd13:5.3: sabbe ninditāyeva honti, garahitāyeva honti, akittitāyeva hontīti –
segments.mnd13:6.2: Tattha sakāya diṭṭhiyā sakāya khantiyā sakāya ruciyā sakāya laddhiyā pasaṃsaṃ thomanaṃ kittiṃ vaṇṇahārikaṃ labhanti paṭilabhanti upagacchanti vindantīti –
segments.mnd13:10.2: Appañhi etanti appakaṃ etaṃ, omakaṃ etaṃ, thokakaṃ etaṃ, lāmakaṃ etaṃ, chatukkaṃ etaṃ, parittakaṃ etanti –
segments.mnd13:10.4: Na alaṃ samāyāti nālaṃ rāgassa samāya, dosassa samāya, mohassa samāya, kodhassa … upanāhassa … makkhassa … paḷāsassa … issāya … macchariyassa … māyāya … sāṭheyyassa … thambhassa … sārambhassa … mānassa … atimānassa … madassa … pamādassa … sabbakilesānaṃ … sabbaduccaritānaṃ … sabbadarathānaṃ … sabbapariḷāhānaṃ … sabbasantāpānaṃ … sabbākusalābhisaṅkhārānaṃ samāya upasamāya vūpasamāya nibbānāya paṭinissaggāya paṭipassaddhiyāti –
segments.mnd13:11.2: Diṭṭhikalahassa diṭṭhibhaṇḍanassa diṭṭhiviggahassa diṭṭhivivādassa diṭṭhimedhagassa dve phalāni honti –
segments.mnd13:11.3: jayaparājayo hoti, lābhālābho hoti, yasāyaso hoti, nindāpasaṃso hoti, sukhadukkhaṃ hoti, somanassadomanassaṃ hoti, iṭṭhāniṭṭhaṃ hoti, anunayapaṭighaṃ hoti, ugghātinigghāti hoti, anurodhavirodho hoti.
segments.mnd13:11.4: Atha vā taṃ kammaṃ nirayasaṃvattanikaṃ, tiracchānayonisaṃvattanikaṃ, pettivisayasaṃvattanikanti brūmi ācikkhāmi desemi paññapemi paṭṭhapemi vivarāmi vibhajāmi uttānīkaromi pakāsemīti –
segments.mnd13:12.2: Etampi disvāti etaṃ ādīnavaṃ disvā passitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā diṭṭhikalahesu diṭṭhibhaṇḍanesu diṭṭhiviggahesu diṭṭhivivādesu diṭṭhimedhagesūti –
segments.mnd13:12.4: Na vivādayethāti na kalahaṃ kareyya, na bhaṇḍanaṃ kareyya, na viggahaṃ kareyya, na vivādaṃ kareyya, na medhagaṃ kareyya, kalahaṃ bhaṇḍanaṃ viggahaṃ vivādaṃ medhagaṃ pajaheyya vinodeyya byantiṃ kareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyya, kalahā bhaṇḍanā viggahā vivādā medhagā ārato assa virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā vihareyyāti –
segments.mnd13:13.3: Yo so sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.
segments.mnd13:13.4: Etaṃ avivādabhūmiṃ khemato tāṇato leṇato saraṇato abhayato accutato amatato nibbānato passanto dakkhanto olokento nijjhāyanto upaparikkhantoti –
segments.mnd13:17.2: Yā kācīti sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ asesaṃ nissesaṃ pariyādiyanavacanametaṃ –
segments.mnd13:17.6: Puthujjāti puthujjanehi janitā sammutiyoti puthujjā, puthu nānājanehi janitā vā sammutiyoti puthujjāti –
segments.mnd13:18.3: Sabbāva etā diṭṭhisammutiyo neti na upeti na upagacchati na gaṇhāti na parāmasati nābhinivisatīti –
segments.mnd13:19.7: taṇhūpayassa pahīnattā, diṭṭhūpayassa paṭinissaṭṭhattā anūpayo puggalo kiṃ rūpaṃ upeyya upagaccheyya gaṇheyya parāmaseyya abhiniviseyya attā meti.
segments.mnd13:19.17: kiṃ vaṭṭaṃ upeyya upagaccheyya gaṇheyya parāmaseyya abhiniveseyyāti –
segments.mnd13:20.2: Diṭṭhe vā diṭṭhasuddhiyā vā sute vā sutasuddhiyā vā mute vā mutasuddhiyā vā khantiṃ akubbamāno chandaṃ akubbamāno pemaṃ akubbamāno rāgaṃ akubbamāno ajanayamāno asañjanayamāno anibbattayamāno anabhinibbattayamānoti –
segments.mnd13:24.3: te sīlamattena saññamamattena saṃvaramattena avītikkamamattena suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parivisuddhiṃ, muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parivimuttiṃ āhu [āhaṃsu (sī. ka.)] vadanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharanti.
segments.mnd13:25.2: “catūhi kho ahaṃ, gahapati, dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññapemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ.
segments.mnd13:25.4: Idha, gahapati, na kāyena pāpakammaṃ karoti, na pāpikaṃ [pāpakaṃ (sī.)] vācaṃ bhāsati, na pāpakaṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti, na pāpakaṃ ājīvaṃ ājīvati.
segments.mnd13:25.5: Imehi kho ahaṃ, gahapati, catūhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññapemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ;
segments.mnd13:25.7: te sīlamattena saññamamattena saṃvaramattena avītikkamamattena suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ, muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttiṃ āhu vadanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharantī”ti –
segments.mnd13:26.2: Vatanti hatthivataṃ vā assavataṃ vā govataṃ vā kukkuravataṃ vā kākavataṃ vā vāsudevavataṃ vā baladevavataṃ vā puṇṇabhaddavataṃ vā maṇibhaddavataṃ vā aggivataṃ vā nāgavataṃ vā supaṇṇavataṃ vā yakkhavataṃ vā asuravataṃ vā gandhabbavataṃ vā mahārājavataṃ vā candavataṃ vā sūriyavataṃ vā indavataṃ vā brahmavataṃ vā devavataṃ vā disāvataṃ vā ādāya samādāya ādiyitvā samādiyitvā gaṇhitvā parāmasitvā abhinivisitvā upaṭṭhitā paccupaṭṭhitā allīnā upagatā ajjhositā adhimuttāti –
segments.mnd13:27.2: Idhāti sakāya diṭṭhiyā sakāya khantiyā sakāya ruciyā sakāya laddhiyā.
segments.mnd13:27.5: Athassa suddhinti athassa suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ, muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttinti –
segments.mnd13:28.4: Kusalāvadānāti kusalavādā paṇḍitavādā thiravādā ñāyavādā hetuvādā lakkhaṇavādā kāraṇavādā ṭhānavādā sakāya laddhiyāti –
segments.mnd13:32.3: paravicchindanāya vā cavati, anabhisambhuṇanto vā cavati.
segments.mnd13:32.5: Paro vicchindati so satthā na sabbaññū, dhammo na svākkhāto, gaṇo na suppaṭipanno, diṭṭhi na bhaddikā, paṭipadā na supaññattā, maggo na niyyāniko, natthettha suddhi vā visuddhi vā parisuddhi vā, mutti vā vimutti vā parimutti vā, natthettha sujjhanti vā visujjhanti vā parisujjhanti vā, muccanti vā vimuccanti vā, parimuccanti vā, hīnā nihīnā omakā lāmakā chatukkā parittāti.
segments.mnd13:32.7: Evaṃ vicchindiyamāno satthārā cavati, dhammakkhānā cavati, gaṇā cavati, diṭṭhiyā cavati, paṭipadāya cavati, maggato cavati.
segments.mnd13:32.10: Sīlaṃ anabhisambhuṇanto sīlato cavati, vataṃ anabhisambhuṇanto vatato cavati, sīlabbataṃ anabhisambhuṇanto sīlabbatato cavati.
segments.mnd13:33.2: Pavedhatīti sīlaṃ vā vataṃ vā sīlabbataṃ vā “viraddhaṃ mayā, aparaddhaṃ mayā, khalitaṃ mayā, galitaṃ mayā, aññāya aparaddho ahan”ti vedhati pavedhati sampavedhatīti –
segments.mnd13:33.4: Kammavirādhayitvāti puññābhisaṅkhāraṃ vā apuññābhisaṅkhāraṃ vā āneñjābhisaṅkhāraṃ vā “viraddhaṃ mayā, aparaddhaṃ mayā, khalitaṃ mayā, galitaṃ mayā, aññāya aparaddho ahan”ti vedhati pavedhati sampavedhatīti –
segments.mnd13:34.2: Pajappatīti sīlaṃ vā jappati, vataṃ vā jappati, sīlabbataṃ vā jappati pajappati abhijappatīti –
segments.mnd13:34.4: Patthayatī ca suddhinti sīlasuddhiṃ vā pattheti, vatasuddhiṃ vā pattheti, sīlabbatasuddhiṃ vā pattheti piheti abhijappatīti –
segments.mnd13:35.2: Yathā puriso gharato nikkhanto satthena pavasaṃ vasanto satthā ohīno, taṃ vā satthaṃ anubandhati sakaṃ vā gharaṃ paccāgacchati;
segments.mnd13:35.3: evameva so diṭṭhigatiko taṃ vā satthāraṃ gaṇhāti aññaṃ vā satthāraṃ gaṇhāti, taṃ vā dhammakkhānaṃ gaṇhāti aññaṃ vā dhammakkhānaṃ gaṇhāti, taṃ vā gaṇaṃ gaṇhāti aññaṃ vā gaṇaṃ gaṇhāti, taṃ vā diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti aññaṃ vā diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti, taṃ vā paṭipadaṃ gaṇhāti aññaṃ vā paṭipadaṃ gaṇhāti, taṃ vā maggaṃ gaṇhāti aññaṃ vā maggaṃ gaṇhāti parāmasati abhinivisatīti –
segments.mnd13:39.2: Sabbā sīlasuddhiyo pahāya pajahitvā vinodetvā byantiṃ karitvā anabhāvaṃ gametvā, sabbā vatasuddhiyo pahāya pajahitvā vinodetvā byantiṃ karitvā anabhāvaṃ gametvā, sabbā sīlabbatasuddhiyo pahāya pajahitvā vinodetvā byantiṃ karitvā anabhāvaṃ gametvāti –
segments.mnd13:40.6: Sāvajjañca kammaṃ anavajjañca kammaṃ pahāya pajahitvā vinodetvā byantiṃ karitvā anabhāvaṃ gametvāti –
segments.mnd13:41.4: asuddhiṃ patthenti, akusale dhamme patthenti, pañca kāmaguṇe patthenti;
segments.mnd13:41.5: suddhiṃ patthenti, dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni patthenti, asuddhiṃ patthenti, akusale dhamme patthenti, pañca kāmaguṇe patthenti, dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni patthenti;
segments.mnd13:41.7: tedhātuke kusale dhamme patthenti, asuddhiṃ patthenti, akusale dhamme patthenti, pañca kāmaguṇe patthenti, dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni patthenti, tedhātuke kusale dhamme patthenti;
segments.mnd13:41.8: suddhiṃ patthenti, puthujjanakalyāṇakā [kalyāṇaputhujjanā (syā.) evamīdisesu ṭhānesu] niyāmāvakkantiṃ [niyāmāvattantiṃ (ka.)] patthenti.
segments.mnd13:41.10: Arahatte patte arahā neva akusale dhamme pattheti, napi pañca kāmaguṇe pattheti, napi dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni pattheti, napi tedhātuke kusale dhamme pattheti, napi niyāmāvakkantiṃ pattheti, napi aggadhammaṃ arahattaṃ pattheti.
segments.mnd13:42.2: Viratoti suddhiasuddhiyā ārato assa virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto, vimariyādikatena cetasā viharatīti –
segments.mnd13:42.4: Careti careyya vicareyya vihareyya iriyeyya vatteyya pāleyya yapeyya yāpeyyāti –
segments.mnd13:42.7: santiyo vuccanti dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni diṭṭhisantiyo agaṇhanto aparāmasanto anabhinivisantoti –
segments.mnd13:45.2: atha vāpi diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā;
segments.mnd13:46.2: Santeke samaṇabrāhmaṇā tapojigucchavādā tapojigucchasārā tapojigucchanissitā ānissitā allīnā upagatā ajjhositā adhimuttāti –
segments.mnd13:47.1: Atha vāpi diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vāti.
segments.mnd13:47.2: Diṭṭhaṃ vā diṭṭhasuddhiṃ vā sutaṃ vā sutasuddhiṃ vā mutaṃ vā mutasuddhiṃ vā nissāya upanissāya gaṇhitvā parāmasitvā abhinivisitvāti –
segments.mnd13:47.3: atha vāpi diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā.
segments.mnd13:48.4: Ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā accantasuddhikā, saṃsārasuddhikā, akiriyadiṭṭhikā, sassatavādā –
segments.mnd13:48.6: Te saṃsāre suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ, muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttiṃ thunanti vadanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharantīti –
segments.mnd13:49.2: Taṇhāti rūpataṇhā saddataṇhā gandhataṇhā rasataṇhā phoṭṭhabbataṇhā dhammataṇhā.
segments.mnd13:49.3: Bhavābhavesūti bhavābhave kammabhave punabbhave kāmabhave, kammabhave kāmabhave punabbhave rūpabhave, kammabhave rūpabhave punabbhave arūpabhave, kammabhave arūpabhave punabbhave punappunabbhave punappunagatiyā punappunaupapattiyā punappunapaṭisandhiyā punappunaattabhāvābhinibbattiyā avītataṇhā avigatataṇhā acattataṇhā avantataṇhā amuttataṇhā appahīnataṇhā appaṭinissaṭṭhataṇhāti –
segments.mnd13:51.2: atha vāpi diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā;
segments.mnd13:52.4: sa kena vedheyya kuhiṃ va jappe.
segments.mnd13:53.3: Yo rāgo sārāgo … pe … abhijjhā lobho akusalamūlaṃ.
segments.mnd13:53.8: Yo rāgo sārāgo … pe … abhijjhā lobho akusalamūlanti –
segments.mnd13:54.7: Pakappitaṃ vatthuṃ acchedasaṅkinopi vedhenti, acchijjantepi vedhenti, acchinnepi vedhenti;
segments.mnd13:54.8: pakappitaṃ vatthuṃ vipariṇāmasaṅkinopi vedhenti, vipariṇamantepi vedhenti, vipariṇatepi vedhenti pavedhenti sampavedhentīti –
segments.mnd13:55.3: Yassa gamanaṃ āgamanaṃ gamanāgamanaṃ kālaṃgati bhavābhavo cuti ca upapatti ca nibbatti ca bhedo ca jāti ca jarāmaraṇañca natthi na santi na saṃvijjanti nupalabbhanti, pahīnā samucchinnā vūpasantā paṭipassaddhā abhabbuppattikā ñāṇagginā daḍḍhāti –
segments.mnd13:56.2: So kena rāgena vedheyya, kena dosena vedheyya, kena mohena vedheyya, kena mānena vedheyya, kāya diṭṭhiyā vedheyya, kena uddhaccena vedheyya, kāya vicikicchāya vedheyya, kehi anusayehi vedheyya –
segments.mnd13:56.3: rattoti vā duṭṭhoti vā mūḷhoti vā vinibaddhoti vā parāmaṭṭhoti vā vikkhepagatoti vā aniṭṭhaṅgatoti vā thāmagatoti vā.
segments.mnd13:56.6: nerayikoti vā tiracchānayonikoti vā pettivisayikoti vā manussoti vā devoti vā rūpīti vā arūpīti vā saññīti vā asaññīti vā nevasaññīnāsaññīti vā, so hetu natthi paccayo natthi kāraṇaṃ natthi yena vedheyya pavedheyya sampavedheyyāti –
segments.mnd13:56.8: Kuhiṃva jappeti kuhiṃ vā jappeyya kimhi jappeyya, kattha jappeyya pajappeyya abhijappeyyāti –
segments.mnd13:56.9: sa kena vedheyya kuhiṃ va jappe.
segments.mnd13:58.4: sa kena vedheyya kuhiṃ va jappe”ti.
segments.mnd13:60.2: Yaṃ dhammaṃ diṭṭhiṃ paṭipadaṃ maggaṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā “idaṃ paramaṃ aggaṃ seṭṭhaṃ visiṭṭhaṃ pāmokkhaṃ uttamaṃ pavaran”ti, evamāhaṃsu evaṃ kathenti evaṃ bhaṇanti evaṃ dīpayanti evaṃ voharantīti –
segments.mnd13:61.1: Tameva hīnanti panāhu aññeti tameva dhammaṃ diṭṭhiṃ paṭipadaṃ maggaṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā “hīnaṃ etaṃ, nihīnaṃ etaṃ, omakaṃ etaṃ, lāmakaṃ etaṃ, chatukkaṃ etaṃ, parittakaṃ etan”ti, evamāhaṃsu evaṃ kathenti evaṃ bhaṇanti evaṃ dīpayanti evaṃ voharantīti –
segments.mnd13:62.2: Imesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ vādo katamo sacco taccho tatho bhūto yāthāvo aviparītoti –
segments.mnd13:63.2: Sabbevime samaṇabrāhmaṇā kusalavādā paṇḍitavādā thiravādā ñāyavādā hetuvādā lakkhaṇavādā kāraṇavādā ṭhānavādā sakāya laddhiyāti –
segments.mnd13:67.1: Sakañhi dhammaṃ paripuṇṇamāhūti sakaṃ dhammaṃ diṭṭhiṃ paṭipadaṃ maggaṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā “idaṃ samattaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ anoman”ti, evamāhaṃsu … pe …
segments.mnd13:68.2: Aññassa dhammaṃ diṭṭhiṃ paṭipadaṃ maggaṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā “hīnaṃ etaṃ, nihīnaṃ etaṃ, omakaṃ etaṃ, lāmakaṃ etaṃ, chatukkaṃ etaṃ, parittakaṃ etan”ti, evamāhaṃsu evaṃ kathenti evaṃ bhaṇanti evaṃ dīpayanti evaṃ voharantīti –
segments.mnd13:69.1: Evampi viggayha vivādayantīti evaṃ gahetvā uggahetvā gaṇhitvā parāmasitvā abhinivisitvā vivādayanti, kalahaṃ karonti, bhaṇḍanaṃ karonti, viggahaṃ karonti, vivādaṃ karonti, medhagaṃ karonti –
segments.mnd13:70.5: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan”ti –
segments.mnd13:74.1: Parassa ce vambhayitena hīnoti parassa ce vambhayitakāraṇā ninditakāraṇā garahitakāraṇā upavaditakāraṇā paro bālo hoti hīno nihīno omako lāmako chatukko parittoti –
segments.mnd13:75.2: Dhammesu na koci aggo seṭṭho visiṭṭho pāmokkho uttamo pavaro assāti –
segments.mnd13:76.2: Bahukāpi bahūnaṃ dhammaṃ vadanti upavadanti nindanti garahanti hīnato nihīnato omakato lāmakato chatukkato parittato, bahukāpi ekassa dhammaṃ vadanti upavadanti nindanti garahanti hīnato nihīnato omakato lāmakato chatukkato parittato, ekopi bahūnaṃ dhammaṃ vadati upavadati nindati garahati hīnato nihīnato omakato lāmakato chatukkato parittato, ekopi ekassa dhammaṃ vadati upavadati nindati garahati hīnato nihīnato omakato lāmakato chatukkato parittatoti –
segments.mnd13:77.2: Dhammo sakāyanaṃ, diṭṭhi sakāyanaṃ, paṭipadā sakāyanaṃ, maggo sakāyanaṃ, sakāyane daḷhavādā thiravādā balikavādā aṭṭhitavādāti –
segments.mnd13:81.3: Sakaṃ satthāraṃ sakkaroti garuṃ karoti māneti pūjeti “ayaṃ satthā sabbaññū”ti –
segments.mnd13:81.5: Sakaṃ dhammakkhānaṃ sakaṃ gaṇaṃ sakaṃ diṭṭhiṃ sakaṃ paṭipadaṃ sakaṃ maggaṃ sakkaroti garuṃ karoti māneti pūjeti “ayaṃ maggo niyyāniko”ti –
segments.mnd13:81.7: Saddhammapūjāpi panā tathevāti saddhammapūjā tathā tacchā bhūtā yāthāvā aviparītāti –
segments.mnd13:82.2: Dhammo sakāyanaṃ diṭṭhi sakāyanaṃ paṭipadā sakāyanaṃ maggo sakāyanaṃ, sakāyanāni pasaṃsanti thomenti kittenti vaṇṇentīti –
segments.mnd13:83.1: Sabbeva vādā tathiyā bhaveyyunti sabbeva vādā tathā tacchā bhūtā yāthāvā aviparītā bhaveyyunti –
segments.mnd13:84.2: Paccattameva tesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ suddhi visuddhi parisuddhi, mutti vimutti parimuttīti –
segments.mnd13:88.3: Brāhmaṇoti sattannaṃ dhammānaṃ bāhitattā brāhmaṇo … pe … asito tādi pavuccate sa brahmā.
segments.mnd13:88.4: Na brāhmaṇassa paraneyyamatthīti brāhmaṇassa paraneyyatā natthi, brāhmaṇo na paraneyyo, na parapattiyo, na parapaccayo, na parapaṭibaddhagū [parapaṭibandhagū (ka.)] jānāti passati asammūḷho sampajāno paṭissato.
segments.mnd13:88.5: “Sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā”ti brāhmaṇassa paraneyyatā natthi, brāhmaṇo na paraneyyo, na parapattiyo, na parapaccayo, na parapaṭibaddhagū jānāti passati asammūḷho sampajāno paṭissato.
segments.mnd13:88.7: “yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamma” ntntti brāhmaṇassa paraneyyatā natthi, brāhmaṇo na paraneyyo, na parapattiyo, na parapaccayo, na parapaṭibaddhagū jānāti passati asammūḷho sampajāno paṭissatoti –
segments.mnd13:89.3: Niccheyyāti nicchinitvā vinicchinitvā vicinitvā pavicinitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā.
segments.mnd13:89.4: Odhiggāho bilaggāho varaggāho koṭṭhāsaggāho uccayaggāho samuccayaggāho “idaṃ saccaṃ tathaṃ bhūtaṃ yāthāvaṃ aviparītan”ti gahitaṃ parāmaṭṭhaṃ abhiniviṭṭhaṃ ajjhositaṃ adhimuttaṃ natthi na santi na saṃvijjati nupalabbhati, pahīnaṃ samucchinnaṃ vūpasantaṃ paṭipassaddhaṃ abhabbuppattikaṃ ñāṇagginā daḍḍhanti –
segments.mnd13:90.2: Tasmāti tasmā taṃkāraṇā taṃhetu tappaccayā taṃnidānā diṭṭhikalahāni diṭṭhibhaṇḍanāni diṭṭhiviggahāni diṭṭhivivādāni diṭṭhimedhagāni upātivatto atikkanto samatikkanto vītivattoti –
segments.mnd13:91.2: Aññaṃ satthāraṃ dhammakkhānaṃ gaṇaṃ diṭṭhiṃ paṭipadaṃ maggaṃ aññatra satipaṭṭhānehi, aññatra sammappadhānehi, aññatra iddhipādehi, aññatra indriyehi, aññatra balehi, aññatra bojjhaṅgehi, aññatra ariyā aṭṭhaṅgikā maggā, aggaṃ seṭṭhaṃ visiṭṭhaṃ pāmokkhaṃ uttamaṃ pavaraṃ dhammaṃ na passati na dakkhati na oloketi na nijjhāyati na upaparikkhatīti –
segments.mnd13:95.2: Jānāmīti paracittañāṇena [paracittavijānanañāṇena (sī.) aṭṭhakathā oloketabbā] vā jānāmi, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇena vā jānāmi.
segments.mnd13:95.3: Passāmīti maṃsacakkhunā vā passāmi, dibbena cakkhunā vā passāmi.
segments.mnd13:95.4: Tatheva etanti etaṃ tathaṃ tacchaṃ bhūtaṃ yāthāvaṃ aviparītanti –
segments.mnd13:96.2: Diṭṭhiyā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ, muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttiṃ paccenti.
segments.mnd13:96.3: “Sassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan”ti diṭṭhiyā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ, muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttiṃ paccenti.
segments.mnd13:96.5: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan”ti diṭṭhiyā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ, muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttiṃ paccentīti –
segments.mnd13:97.2: Adakkhīti paracittañāṇena vā adakkhi, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇena vā adakkhi, maṃsacakkhunā vā adakkhi, dibbena cakkhunā vā adakkhīti –
segments.mnd13:97.6: Na dukkhapariññā atthi, na samudayassa pahānaṃ atthi, na maggabhāvanā atthi, na phalasacchikiriyā atthi, na rāgassa samucchedapahānaṃ atthi, na dosassa samucchedapahānaṃ atthi, na mohassa samucchedapahānaṃ atthi, na kilesānaṃ samucchedapahānaṃ atthi, na saṃsāravaṭṭassa upacchedo atthīti –
segments.mnd13:98.1: Atisitvā aññena vadanti suddhinti te titthiyā suddhimaggaṃ visuddhimaggaṃ parisuddhimaggaṃ vodātamaggaṃ parivodātamaggaṃ atikkamitvā samatikkamitvā vītivattitvā aññatra satipaṭṭhānehi, aññatra sammappadhānehi, aññatra iddhipādehi, aññatra indriyehi, aññatra balehi aññatra bojjhaṅgehi, aññatra ariyā aṭṭhaṅgikā maggā suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ, muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttiṃ vadanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharantīti.
segments.mnd13:99.1: Atha vā buddhā ca buddhasāvakā ca paccekabuddhā ca tesaṃ titthiyānaṃ asuddhimaggaṃ avisuddhimaggaṃ aparisuddhimaggaṃ avodātamaggaṃ aparivodātamaggaṃ atikkamitvā samatikkamitvā vītivattitvā catūhi satipaṭṭhānehi catūhi sammappadhānehi catūhi iddhipādehi pañcahi indriyehi pañcahi balehi sattahi bojjhaṅgehi ariyena aṭṭhaṅgikena maggena suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ, muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttiṃ vadanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharantīti –
segments.mnd13:102.4: na hi tena suddhiṃ kusalā vadanti.
segments.mnd13:103.1: Passaṃ naro dakkhati nāmarūpanti passaṃ naro dakkhati paracittañāṇena vā passanto, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇena vā passanto, maṃsacakkhunā vā passanto, dibbena cakkhunā vā passanto nāmarūpaṃyeva dakkhati niccato sukhato attato, na tesaṃ dhammānaṃ samudayaṃ vā atthaṅgamaṃ vā assādaṃ vā ādīnavaṃ vā nissaraṇaṃ vā dakkhatīti –
segments.mnd13:104.2: Disvāti paracittañāṇena vā disvā, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇena vā disvā, maṃsacakkhunā vā disvā, dibbena cakkhunā vā disvā, nāmarūpaṃyeva disvā ñāyati niccato sukhato attato, na tesaṃ dhammānaṃ samudayaṃ vā atthaṅgamaṃ vā assādaṃ vā ādīnavaṃ vā nissaraṇaṃ vā ñāyatīti – disvāna vā ñāyati tānimeva.
segments.mnd13:105.2: Kāmaṃ bahukaṃ vā passanto nāmarūpaṃ appakaṃ vā niccato sukhato attatoti –
segments.mnd13:106.2: Kusalāti ye te khandhakusalā dhātukusalā āyatanakusalā paṭiccasamuppādakusalā satipaṭṭhānakusalā sammappadhānakusalā iddhipādakusalā indriyakusalā balakusalā bojjhaṅgakusalā maggakusalā phalakusalā nibbānakusalā, te kusalā paracittañāṇena vā pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇena vā maṃsacakkhunā vā dibbena cakkhunā vā nāmarūpadassanena suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttiṃ na vadanti na kathenti na bhaṇanti na dīpayanti na voharantīti –
segments.mnd13:106.3: na hi tena suddhiṃ kusalā vadanti.
segments.mnd13:108.4: na hi tena suddhiṃ kusalā vadantī”ti.
segments.mnd13:110.4: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan”ti –
segments.mnd13:110.7: Nivissavādī dubbinayo duppaññāpayo [duppaññāpiyo (sī.) evamīdisesu ṭhānesu] dunnijjhāpayo duppekkhāpayo duppasādayoti –
segments.mnd13:111.2: Kappitā pakappitā abhisaṅkhatā saṇṭhapitā diṭṭhiṃ purekkhato katvā carati.
segments.mnd13:111.3: Diṭṭhidhajo diṭṭhiketu diṭṭhādhipateyyo diṭṭhiyā parivārito caratīti –
segments.mnd13:112.2: Yaṃ nissitoti yaṃ satthāraṃ dhammakkhānaṃ gaṇaṃ diṭṭhiṃ paṭipadaṃ maggaṃ nissito ānissito allīno upagato ajjhosito adhimuttoti –
segments.mnd13:112.4: Tatthāti sakāya diṭṭhiyā sakāya khantiyā sakāya ruciyā sakāya laddhiyā.
segments.mnd13:112.5: Subhaṃ vadānoti subhavādo sobhanavādo paṇḍitavādo thiravādo ñāyavādo hetuvādo lakkhaṇavādo kāraṇavādo ṭhānavādo sakāya laddhiyāti –
segments.mnd13:113.3: Atha vā suddhidassano visuddhidassano parisuddhidassano vodātadassano parivodātadassanoti –
segments.mnd13:113.5: Tatthāti sakāya diṭṭhiyā sakāya khantiyā sakāya ruciyā sakāya laddhiyā tathaṃ tacchaṃ bhūtaṃ yāthāvaṃ aviparītanti addassa adakkhi apassi paṭivijjhīti –
segments.mnd13:117.3: Brāhmaṇoti sattannaṃ dhammānaṃ bāhitattā brāhmaṇo … pe … asito tādi pavuccate sa brahmā.
segments.mnd13:117.9: Yā paññā pajānanā … pe … amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi.
segments.mnd13:117.11: Brāhmaṇo saṅkhāya jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā.
segments.mnd13:117.14: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamma” ntntti saṅkhāya jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā taṇhākappaṃ vā diṭṭhikappaṃ vā neti na upeti na upagacchati na gaṇhāti na parāmasati nābhinivisatīti –
segments.mnd13:118.2: Tassa dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni pahīnāni samucchinnāni vūpasantāni paṭipassaddhāni abhabbuppattikāni ñāṇagginā daḍḍhāni.
segments.mnd13:118.3: So diṭṭhiyā na yāyati na nīyati na vuyhati na saṃharīyati napi taṃ diṭṭhigataṃ sārato pacceti na paccāgacchatīti –
segments.mnd13:118.5: Napi ñāṇabandhūti aṭṭhasamāpattiñāṇena vā pañcābhiññāñāṇena vā taṇhābandhuṃ vā diṭṭhibandhuṃ vā na karoti na janeti na sañjaneti na nibbatteti nābhinibbattetīti –
segments.mnd13:119.2: Ñatvāti ñatvā jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā.
segments.mnd13:119.3: “Sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā”ti ñatvā jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā,
segments.mnd13:119.5: “yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman”ti ñatvā jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvāti –
segments.mnd13:119.10: Puthu nānājanehi janitā vā sammutiyoti puthujjāti –
segments.mnd13:120.2: Aññe taṇhāvasena diṭṭhivasena gaṇhanti parāmasanti abhinivisanti.
segments.mnd13:120.3: Arahā upekkhati na gaṇhāti na parāmasati nābhinivisatīti –
segments.mnd13:124.3: abhijjhā kāyagantho, byāpādo kāyagantho, sīlabbataparāmāso kāyagantho, idaṃsaccābhiniveso kāyagantho.
segments.mnd13:124.4: Attano diṭṭhiyā rāgo abhijjhā kāyagantho, paravādesu āghāto appaccayo byāpādo kāyagantho, attano sīlaṃ vā vataṃ vā sīlabbataṃ vā parāmasati sīlabbataparāmāso kāyagantho, attano diṭṭhiṃ abhiniveso kāyagantho idaṃsaccābhiniveso kāyagantho.
segments.mnd13:124.6: Atha vā ganthe gadhite ganthite [gathite gaṇṭhite (bahūsu) suddhaṭṭhakasutte sattamagāthāvaṇṇanā oloketabbā] bandhe vibandhe ābandhe [baddhe vibaddhe ābaddhe (sī.)] lagge laggite palibuddhe bandhane phoṭayitvā vissajja.
segments.mnd13:124.7: Yathā vayhaṃ vā rathaṃ vā sakaṭaṃ vā sandamānikaṃ vā sajjaṃ vissajjaṃ karonti vikopenti;
segments.mnd13:124.9: Atha vā ganthe gathite gaṇṭhite bandhe vibandhe ābandhe lagge laggite palibuddhe bandhane phoṭayitvā vissajja.
segments.mnd13:124.11: Monaṃ vuccati ñāṇaṃ … pe … saṅgajālamaticca so muni.
segments.mnd13:125.2: Vivādajātesu sañjātesu nibbattesu abhinibbattesu pātubhūtesu [vivāde jāte sañjāte nibbatte abhinibbatte pātubhūte (sī. ka.)] chandāgatiṃ gacchantesu dosāgatiṃ gacchantesu bhayāgatiṃ gacchantesu mohāgatiṃ gacchantesu na chandāgatiṃ gacchati, na dosāgatiṃ gacchati, na bhayāgatiṃ gacchati, na mohāgatiṃ gacchati, na rāgavasena gacchati, na dosavasena gacchati, na mohavasena gacchati, na mānavasena gacchati, na diṭṭhivasena gacchati, na uddhaccavasena gacchati, na vicikicchāvasena gacchati, na anusayavasena gacchati, na vaggehi dhammehi yāyati nīyati vuyhati saṃharīyatīti –
segments.mnd13:126.2: Santoti rāgassa santattā santo, dosassa santattā santo, mohassa santattā santo … pe … sabbākusalābhisaṅkhārānaṃ santattā samitattā vūpasamitattā vijjhātattā nibbutattā vigatattā paṭipassaddhattā santo upasanto vūpasanto nibbuto paṭipassaddhoti –
segments.mnd13:126.6: Upekkhako soti arahā chaḷaṅgupekkhāya samannāgato cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā neva sumano hoti na dummano upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno.
segments.mnd13:127.2: Aññe taṇhāvasena diṭṭhivasena gaṇhante parāmasante abhinivisante.
segments.mnd13:127.3: Arahā upekkhati na gaṇhāti na parāmasati nābhinivisatīti –
segments.mnd13:131.3: Atīte saṅkhāre ārabbha ye kilesā uppajjeyyuṃ te kilese hitvā cajitvā pariccajitvā pajahitvā vinodetvā byantiṃ karitvā anabhāvaṃ gametvāti –
segments.mnd13:131.6: Paccuppanne saṅkhāre ārabbha chandaṃ [khantiṃ (ka.)] akubbamāno pemaṃ akubbamāno rāgaṃ akubbamāno ajanayamāno asañjanayamāno anibbattayamāno anabhinibbattayamānoti –
segments.mnd13:132.2: Na chandāgatiṃ gacchati, na dosāgatiṃ gacchati, na mohāgatiṃ gacchati, na bhayāgatiṃ gacchati, na rāgavasena gacchati, na dosavasena gacchati, na mohavasena gacchati, na mānavasena gacchati, na diṭṭhivasena gacchati, na uddhaccavasena gacchati, na vicikicchāvasena gacchati, na anusayavasena gacchati, na vaggehi dhammehi yāyati nīyati vuyhati na saṃharīyatīti –
segments.mnd13:132.4: Nopi nivissavādīti “sassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan”ti na nivissavādī … pe …
segments.mnd13:132.5: “neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan”ti na nivissavādīti –
segments.mnd13:133.1: Sa vippamutto diṭṭhigatehi dhīroti tassa dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni pahīnāni samucchinnāni vūpasantāni paṭipassaddhāni abhabbuppattikāni ñāṇagginā daḍḍhāni.
segments.mnd13:133.2: So diṭṭhigatehi vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharati.
segments.mnd13:133.3: Dhīroti dhīro paṇḍito paññavā buddhimā ñāṇī vibhāvī medhāvīti –
segments.mnd13:134.7: tassa taṇhālepassa pahīnattā, diṭṭhilepassa paṭinissaṭṭhattā apāyaloke na limpati, manussaloke na limpati, devaloke na limpati, khandhaloke na limpati, dhātuloke na limpati, āyatanaloke na limpati na palimpati na upalimpati, alitto apalitto anupalitto nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharatīti –
segments.mnd13:135.3: Kathaṃ katattā ca akatattā ca attānaṃ garahati?
segments.mnd13:135.4: “Kataṃ me kāyaduccaritaṃ, akataṃ me kāyasucaritan”ti attānaṃ garahati.
segments.mnd13:135.8: katā me micchādiṭṭhi, akatā me sammādiṭṭhī”ti attānaṃ garahati.
segments.mnd13:135.9: Evaṃ katattā ca akatattā ca attānaṃ garahati.
segments.mnd13:136.1: Atha vā “sīlesumhi na paripūrakārī”ti attānaṃ garahati.
segments.mnd13:136.17: Evaṃ katattā ca akatattā ca attānaṃ garahati.
segments.mnd13:136.19: Tayidaṃ kammaṃ akubbamāno ajanayamāno asañjanayamāno anibbattayamāno anabhinibbattayamāno anattagarahīti –
segments.mnd13:139.2: yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā;
segments.mnd13:139.4: na kappiyo nūparato na patthiyo.[iti bhagavā]

lines: Terasame mahābyūhasuttaniddese ye kecime diṭṭhiparibbasānāti idampi “kiṃ nu kho ime diṭṭhiparibbasānā viññūnaṃ santikā nindameva labhanti, udāhu pasaṃsampī”ti uppannacittānaṃ ekaccānaṃ devatānaṃ tamatthaṃ āvikātuṃ purimanayeneva nimmitabuddhena attānaṃ pucchāpetvā vuttaṃ.

Idāni yasmā te “idameva saccan”ti vadantāpi diṭṭhigatikavādino kadāci katthaci pasaṃsampi labhanti, yaṃ etaṃ pasaṃsāsaṅkhātaṃ vādaphalaṃ, taṃ appaṃ, rāgādīnaṃ samāya samatthaṃ na hoti, ko pana vādo dutiye nindāphale, tasmā etamatthaṃ dassento imaṃ tāva vissajjanagāthaṃ āha “appañhi etaṃ na alaṃ samāya, duve vivādassa phalāni brūmī”ti.
Tattha duve vivādassa phalānīti nindā ca pasaṃsā ca jayaparājayādīni vā taṃsabhāgāni.
Etampi disvāti “nindā aniṭṭhā eva, pasaṃsā nālaṃ samāyā”ti etampi vivādaphale ādīnavaṃ disvā.
So upayaṃ kimeyyāti so upagantabbaṭṭhena upayaṃ rūpādīsu ekampi dhammaṃ kiṃ upeyya, kena vā kāraṇena upeyya.
Puthu nānājanehi janitā vāti anekavidhehi diṭṭhigatikehi uppāditā vā.
Ito bāhirā pana – sīluttamāti gāthā tassattho – sīlaṃyeva “uttaman”ti maññamānā sīluttamāti eke bhonto saṃyamamattena suddhiṃ vadanti, hatthivatādiñca vataṃ samādāya upaṭṭhitāse.
Idheva diṭṭhiyaṃ assa satthuno suddhiṃ bhavūpanītā bhavajjhositā samānā vadanti, api ca te kusalāvadānā “kusalā mayan”ti evaṃvādā.
Evaṃ sīluttamesu ca tesu tathā paṭipanno yo koci – sace cutoti gāthā.
Tassattho – sace tato sīlavatato paravicchindanena vā anabhisambhuṇanto vā cuto hoti, so taṃ sīlabbatakammaṃ puññābhisaṅkhārādikammaṃ vā virādhayitvā vedhatī.
Na kevalañca vedhati, api ca kho taṃ sīlabbatasuddhiṃ pajappatī ca vippalapati ca patthayatī ca.
Satthāva hīno pavasaṃ gharamhā, gharamhā pavasanto satthato hīno yathā taṃ gharaṃ vā satthaṃ vā patthayatīti.
Taṃ vā satthaṃ anubandhatīti taṃ vā satthaṃ sabbattha pacchato gacchati.
Evaṃ pana sīluttamānaṃ pavedhanakāraṇaṃ ariyasāvako sīlabbataṃ vāpi pahāya sabbanti gāthā.
Etaṃ suddhiṃ asuddhinti apatthayānoti pañcakāmaguṇādibhedaṃ suddhiṃ akusalādibhedaṃ asuddhiñca apatthayamāno.
Virato careti suddhiyā asuddhiyā ca virato careyya.
Evaṃ ito bāhirake sīluttame saṃyamena visuddhivāde tesañca vipākaṃ sīlabbatapahāyino arahato ca paṭipattiṃ dassetvā idāni aññathāpi suddhivāde bāhirake dassento “tamūpanissāyā”ti gāthamāha.

Tassattho – santaññepi samaṇabrāhmaṇā, te jigucchitaṃ amarantapaṃ vā diṭṭhasuddhiādīsu vā aññataraññataraṃ upanissāya akiriyadiṭṭhiyā vā uddhaṃsarā hutvā bhavābhavesu avītataṇhā suddhi’ manutthunanti vadanti kathentīti.

Evaṃ tesaṃ avītataṇhānaṃ suddhiṃ anutthunantānaṃ yopi suddhippattameva attānaṃ maññeyya, tassāpi avītataṇhattā bhavābhavesu taṃ taṃ vatthuṃ patthayamānassa hi jappitāni punappunaṃ hontiyevāti adhippāyo.
Taṇhā hi āsevitā taṇhaṃ vaḍḍhayateva, na kevalañca jappitāni, pavedhitaṃ vāpi pakappitesu, taṇhādiṭṭhīhi cassa pakappitesu vatthūsu pavedhitampi hotīti vuttaṃ hoti.
Bhavābhavesu pana vītataṇhattā āyatiṃ cutūpapāto idha yassa natthi, sa kena vedheyya kuhiṃ va jappeti ayametissā gāthāya sambandho.
Idāni yasmā ekopi ettha vādo sacco natthi, kevalaṃ diṭṭhimattakena hi te vadanti, tasmā tamatthaṃ dassento “sakaṃ hī”ti imaṃ tāva vissajjanagāthamāha.
Evametesu sakaṃ dhammaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ brūvantesu aññassa dhammaṃ pana hīnanti vadantesu yassa kassaci – parassa ce vambhayitena hīnoti gāthā.
Tassattho – yadi parassa ninditakāraṇā hīno bhaveyya, na koci dhammesu visesi aggo bhaveyya.
Puthū hi aññassa vadanti dhammaṃ nihīnato sabbeva te samhi daḷhaṃ vadānā sakadhamme daḷhavādā eva.
Tassattho – te ca titthiyā yathā pasaṃsanti sakāyanāni, saddhammapūjāpi nesaṃ tatheva vattati.
Tattha yadi te pamāṇā siyuṃ, evaṃ sante sabbeva vādā tathiyā bhaveyyuṃ.
Na sā aññattha sijjhati, nāpi paramatthato.
Attani diṭṭhigāhamattameva hi taṃ tesaṃ parapaccayaneyyabuddhīnaṃ.
Yo pana viparītato bāhitapāpattā brāhmaṇo, tassa na brāhmaṇassa paraneyyamatthīti gāthā.
Tassattho – brāhmaṇassa hi “sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā”tiādinā nayena sudiṭṭhattā parena netabbaṃ ñāṇaṃ natthi.
Taṃkāraṇā so diṭṭhikalahāni atikkanto, na hi so seṭṭhato passati dhammamaññaṃ aññatra satipaṭṭhānādīhi.
Na paraneyyoti parena netabbo jānāpetabbo na hoti.
Na parapattiyo na parapaccayoti paresaṃ paccetabbo na hoti.

Jānāmīti gāthāya sambandho attho ca – evaṃ tāva paramatthabrāhmaṇo na hi seṭṭhato passati dhammamaññaṃ, aññe pana titthiyā paracittañāṇādīhi jānantāpi passantāpi “jānāmi passāmi tatheva etan”ti evaṃ vadantāpi ca diṭṭhiyā suddhiṃ paccenti.

Yasmā tesu ekopi adakkhi ce addasa cepi tena paracittañāṇādinā yathābhūtamatthaṃ, kiñhi tumassa tena tassa tena dassanena kiṃ kataṃ, kiṃ dukkhapariññā sādhitā, udāhu samudayappahānādīnaṃ aññataraṃ, yato sabbathāpi atikkamitvā ariyamaggaṃ te titthiyā aññeneva vadanti suddhiṃ, atikkamitvā vā te titthiye buddhādayo aññeneva vadanti suddhinti.
Passaṃ naroti gāthāya sambandho attho ca – kiñca bhiyyo?
Yvāyaṃ paracittañāṇādīhi addakkhi, so passaṃ naro dakkhati nāmarūpaṃ, na tato paraṃ, disvāna vā ñassati tānimeva nāmarūpāni niccato sukhato vā, na aññathā;
so evaṃ passanto kāmaṃ bahuṃ passatu appakaṃ vā nāmarūpaṃ niccato sukhato ca athassa evarūpena dassanena na hi tena suddhiṃ kusalā vadanti.

Nivissavādīti gāthāya sambandho attho ca – tena ca dassanena suddhiyā asatiyāpi yo “jānāmi passāmi tatheva etan”ti evaṃ nivissavādī, etaṃ vā dassanaṃ paṭicca diṭṭhiyā suddhiṃ paccento “idameva saccan”ti evaṃ nivissavādī, so subbinayo na hoti taṃ tathā pakappitaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ diṭṭhiṃ purakkharāno.
So hi yaṃ satthārādiṃ nissito, tattheva subhaṃ vadāno suddhiṃ vado,“parisuddhivādo parisuddhidassano vā ahan”ti attānaṃ maññamāno tattha tathaddasā so, tattha sakāya diṭṭhiyā aviparītameva so addasa.
Yathā sā diṭṭhi pavattati, tatheva taṃ addasa, na aññathā passituṃ icchatīti adhippāyo.
Dunnijjhāpayoti cittena vīmaṃsitvā gahaṇatthaṃ punappunaṃ nijjhāpayituṃ dukkho.
Evaṃ pakappitaṃ diṭṭhiṃ purakkharānesu titthiyesu – na brāhmaṇo kappamupeti saṅkhāti gāthā.
Tattha viggaho – nāpi assa ñāṇena kato bandhu atthīti napi ñāṇabandhu.
Uggahaṇanti maññeti uggahaṇanti aññe, aññe tā sammutiyo uggaṇhantīti vuttaṃ hoti.
Tattha anuggahoti uggahaṇavirahito, sopi nāssa uggahoti anuggaho.
Tattha sabbadhammesūti dvāsaṭṭhidiṭṭhidhammesu “yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ vā”ti evaṃpabhedesu.
Na kappetīti na kappiyo, duvidhampi kappaṃ na karotīti attho.
Taṇhā hi patthayatīti patthiyā, nāssa patthiyāti na patthiyo.
Ito parañca heṭṭhā ca tattha tattha vuttanayattā uttānatthameva.
Evaṃ arahattanikūṭeneva desanaṃ niṭṭhāpesi, desanāpariyosāne purābhedasutte (mahāni.83) vuttasadiso eva abhisamayo ahosīti.
